Name: Bog's Frogs Get Bows
Author: TheRosieWolf
Description:
This is my first-ever mod! This mod is made to be used with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/BogWyytch]BogWyytch's[/url] mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26207]Bog's Frog Sprinklers[/url]. With this mod, you can change the pressure nozzles you get from Qi's into bowties <3 Made for Content Patcher.

[s]As of right now, there aren't any images for when the pressure nozzle is in your inventory. It is something I plan on updating this mod with in the near future, as well as potentially adding more color variations.
[/s]
New update, 1.1.0 now has item image for inventory :)

Manifest.Name: Bog's Frogs Get Bows
Manifest.Description: Changes the look of pressure nozzles to bowties, made for BogWyytch's Frog Sprinklers.
